assets.label: Exhibit 11-19
assets.caption: Pipe Rack Anchor Bent
assets.description: Hand-drawn engineering drawing showing two views of a pipe rack anchor bent. The plan view (top) shows expansion loops rising above the rack with piping anchored at a designated point near the pumps. The elevation view (bottom) shows the anchor bent with cross-bracing between the rack columns. Caption block 'EXHIBIT 11-19 Pipe Rack Anchor Bent' appears at the upper right of the figure.
